plan.slice: append-only production writer lease fence binds exact signed grant

change.summary: Derive the local fencing digest from the exact grant digest and opaque verifier token, preventing an active append-only lease from being reopened under a different signed grant that reuses token and epochs.
invariants: A changed grant digest returns StaleReceipt before reopen or journal mutation.
The existing active lease head remains unchanged after the rejected reopen.
Queued receipts and dispatch validation use the same grant-bound fence.
No mutable grant column or historical receipt rewrite is introduced.

compatibility_boundary: Existing persisted leases written with the prior token-only fence version fail closed on reopen until an independently authorized lease is acquired; no automatic migration or historical rewrite is performed.
known_gaps: No external signer/trust-root or provider-owned physical exactly-once evidence.
No physical power-loss/media durability run has been executed.
This is not a production authority or promotion receipt.
receipt_sha256_basis: SHA-256 of the final canonical receipt file is reported with this artifact; this receipt carries qualification evidence only and is not an authority grant.
